_comment: Hand-added events merged into the daily Airtable export. Use this for one-offs the
scraper cannot see - out-of-area venues, word-of-mouth shows, late additions.
Shape matches an Airtable record so these flow through the same transform and ICS
path as everything else. Start/End are Europe/London wall-clock times: write the
time the venue advertises, no Z suffix, no offset maths.
Omit End to get the default 2-hour run time. Give each event a stable, unique id -
it becomes the calendar UID, so changing it makes subscribers see a new event.
An entry is dropped automatically if Airtable already has the same title on the
same date, so it is safe to leave one here after the scraper starts finding it.
